subject: The feature 200% of users requested
preview_text: You heard it here first. What's coming to Volume Booster next.
body_paragraphs: Remember when you first boosted your volume and heard your music the way it was meant to sound? That rush of bass, the clarity in every note. Well, we're about to double down on that feeling. I've been locked in a basement studio for weeks, and I finally cracked a code that'll change how you listen to everything.

Here's the deal: thousands of you have been asking for one thing we didn't have. A way to save your own custom EQ presets. No more scrolling through generic settings. You want your morning commute mix to punch harder than a double espresso. Your late-night podcasts need that warm, intimate tone. I heard you, and the next update delivers it.

Starting next week, Premium users get unlimited custom preset slots. Drag the sliders to your perfect sound—more bass, sharper highs, whatever your ears crave—and save it with a name. 'My Car Jam,' 'Bedtime Stories,' 'Gym Grind.' Then switch between them with one tap. It's like having a personal sound engineer in your pocket.

Open the app now, tap the EQ tab, and tweak your current preset. Get a feel for what's possible. When the update drops, you'll be ready to save your masterpiece. P.S. I'm testing a secret mode that auto-adjusts volume based on your surroundings. More on that soon—only for those who stick around.
